parameters.jsCode: function fail(code,message,rid='req_error'){return [{json:{valid:false,result:{success:false,data:null,error:{code,message},requestId:rid}}}];}const item=$input.first(),q=item.json.query??{};try{for(const k of ['workspaceId','campaignId'])if(!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(q[k]??''))throw Error(k+' is required.');if(typeof q.requestId!=='string'||q.requestId.length<8||q.requestId.length>128)throw Error('requestId must contain 8–128 characters.');if(Object.keys(item.binary??{}).length!==1||!item.binary.file)throw Error('Upload one file in field file.');const f=item.binary.file,format=String(f.fileExtension??f.fileName?.split('.').pop()??'').toLowerCase();if(!['csv','xlsx'].includes(format))throw Error('Use CSV or XLSX.');const bytes=await this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer(0,'file');if(bytes.length>5*1024*1024)throw Error('Maximum upload size is 5 MB.');if(format==='xlsx'){if(bytes.length<22)throw Error('Invalid XLSX archive.');let end=-1;for(let z=bytes.length-22;z>=Math.max(0,bytes.length-65557);z--){if(bytes.readUInt32LE(z)===0x06054b50){end=z;break;}}if(end<0)throw Error('Invalid XLSX archive.');const count=bytes.readUInt16LE(end+10);let cursor=bytes.readUInt32LE(end+16),total=0;if(count>200||cursor===0xffffffff)throw Error('Unsupported XLSX archive.');for(let z=0;z<count;z++){if(cursor+46>end||bytes.readUInt32LE(cursor)!==0x02014b50)throw Error('Invalid XLSX directory.');const size=bytes.readUInt32LE(cursor+24);if(size===0xffffffff||(bytes.readUInt16LE(cursor+8)&1))throw Error('Encrypted or ZIP64 XLSX is not supported.');total+=size;if(total>25*1024*1024)throw Error('XLSX decompressed size exceeds 25 MB.');cursor+=46+bytes.readUInt16LE(cursor+28)+bytes.readUInt16LE(cursor+30)+bytes.readUInt16LE(cursor+32);}}return [{json:{valid:true,userId:item.json.userId,query:q,format},binary:item.binary}];}catch(e){return fail('INVALID_REQUEST',e.message,q.requestId);}
